new_files.description: Empty package marker for Chronicle application root.
Identical pattern to FoodTracker/backend/database.py. psycopg2 SimpleConnectionPool using ATLAS_PG_* env vars. Exports init_pool() and get_db() context manager.

FastAPI router. prefix=/api/chronicle, tag=calendar. Three endpoints: GET /calendar/sources, GET /calendar/events, PATCH /calendar/sources. All queries against shared_views.calendar_event_view and shared_views.calendar_source_selection.

FastAPI app entry. Mirrors FoodTracker/backend/main.py. app_name='chronicle', port=8013. Includes calendar router with prefix=/api. Uses platform_errorhandling for logging, exception handlers, request timing.
Local dev runner. Mirrors FoodTracker/run_local.py. Loads secrets from 01_System/secrets.env, sets ATLAS_PG_HOST=127.0.0.1, runs uvicorn on port 8013.
Mirrors FoodTracker Dockerfile. Sets PYTHONPATH to include 02_Platform/packages. Exposes port 8000. CMD uvicorn backend.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000.
Docker Compose service. service name: chronicle. container: atlas-chronicle. port: 127.0.0.1:8013:8000. Joins atlas-net. ATLAS_PG_HOST=atlas-postgres. Mirrors FoodTracker compose.yml.
AppRegistry.register call as side-effect. appId='chronicle', label='Chronicle', basePath='/chronicle'. Nav: single entry — { id: 'calendar', label: 'Calendar', path: '/chronicle', order: 1 }.
Default-export React component. Renders <Routes> with single route: path='/' -> CalendarPage. No BrowserRouter (inherits shell context).

Main page component. Fetches sources on mount. Manages: sources[], activeSrc (application+source_label pair | null), selectedDay (CalendarEventRow | null). Renders SourceChooser + conditional HeatmapRenderer + DayDetailView.
Props: sources (SourceListRow[]), onToggle(application: string, source_label: string, selected: boolean): void. Renders list of sources with checkmark indicator.
Props: application (string), source_label (string), onDayClick(row: CalendarEventRow | null): void. Fetches events on mount/change. Renders 52x7 calendar grid for current year. Inline implementation.
Props: row (CalendarEventRow | null). Renders date, application, source_label, label, value fields. Returns null when row is null.

changes: Add schema-chronicle target: applies 00_Blueprint/SharedViews/chronicle.sql via psql.
Add chronicle-build, chronicle-up, chronicle-down, chronicle-logs, chronicle-reboot targets (mirrors food-* pattern).

blueprint_file_already_exists.status: Present and correct. Defines shared_views schema, calendar_source_selection table, calendar_event_view with workout and food sources. No changes required for this sprint.

env_vars_required: ATLAS_PG_HOST (set to atlas-postgres in Docker, 127.0.0.1 for local dev)

4. run_local.py, Dockerfile, compose.yml — infra wiring (adapt from FoodTracker, change port to 8013)
